{{Top|leg}}
A '''tactile array''' was part of the technology used aboard the ''[[Coral Vanda]]'' in their adventure rooms. In conjunction with [[holographic generator]]s and [[olfactory emitter]]s, tactile arrays created realistic simulations of other environments. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the ''Coral Vanda'' had four adventure rooms, and the technology was used to create simulations of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Imperial Plaza]], the sky [[City/Legends|cities]] of [[Tranthellix]], a bazaar on an [[Ithorian Herdship]] and [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest's]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] caverns.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
